integrity: Contains complete deterministic standard-library verifier and all 70 graph clique values; literature comparisons distinguish previous existence bounds and small m counts from the claimed first-occurrence spectrum.
scientific_limitations: Exactly odd prime fields and tuple cardinalities 2 through 12. Exact branch-and-bound finite enumeration, no asymptotic or higher-size theorem. Prior unindexed exact tables remain possible.
title: First-occurrence spectrum of prime-field Diophantine tuples through size twelve
